title: Pottery Palettes - Resource Pack
description: The resource pack for the Pottery Palettes data pack: Making all pottery sherds dyeable in the 16 dye colours + adds some new sherds from Minecraft Dungeons!
body:
This is the resource pack for the [Pottery Palettes Data Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/pottery-palettes)!

Notice: This resource pack does nothing on its own, and only serves to supply textures for the [Pottery Palettes Data Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/pottery-palettes). So just be sure you're using the [Pottery Palettes Data Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/pottery-palettes) in your world when getting this resource pack :D

All pottery sherd patterns in all dye colours for millions of combinations!

A simple vanilla data pack to add to your world, if you enjoy expanding Minecraft and exploring its extended canon

Includes 4 new pottery patterns inspired by Minecraft Dungeons for more Minecraft in Minecraft!
